name: Cheech & Chong - 1g Cart - Sour Jack (S)
description:
Sharp, zesty, and wide awake. The Cheech & Chong Sour Jack cartridge holds 1 gram of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — in a universal-fit 510-thread cart that screws right onto any standard battery. Simple, reliable, and made to last.

Sour Jack delivers a bold, tangy profile: sharp sour citrus up front cut with a spicy-herbal edge and a smooth, diesel-tinged finish. Blended with a sativa terpene profile for an uplifting, energizing feel — bright and fast-moving, made for daytime and staying productive.

Why you'll love it:

1G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor
Universal 510-thread fit — works with any standard 510 battery
Signature Sour Jack flavor — tangy sour citrus with spicy-herbal and diesel notes
Sativa terpene blend — uplifting and energizing, ideal for daytime
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Bold flavor and dependable quality in a classic, easy-to-use cartridge. Just attach your battery and enjoy — Cheech & Chong Sour Jack is ready when you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
